intro: Capital of Chhattisgarh and heart of the rice bowl, Raipur grows shinier by the year with new malls and arenas. Gifts reach Amlidih, Devendra Nagar and the VIP Road stretch, plus industrial-side orders toward Urla.

faqs.q: Do you deliver to Urla industrial area?
faqs.a: Yes — Urla deliveries follow the Raipur route with factory-timing handovers during working hours.

faqs.q: How fast is delivery to Amlidih?
faqs.a: Amlidih and VIP Road complete within the standard 48–72 hour window, often faster on weekdays.

name: Rajkot
intro: Saurashtra’s engine room pairs engineering hustle with famously warm Gujarati hospitality. Celebrations call for fafda-jalebi trays as much as cakes, and we deliver both styles of joy across Kalavad Road, University Road and the Ring Road colonies.

faqs.q: Can I add my own snacks to a Giftora hamper in Rajkot?
faqs.a: Yes — combine your fafda-jalebi picks with our sweet boxes; WhatsApp us for combined pickup-and-delivery.

faqs.q: Is Nana Mava covered for delivery?
faqs.a: Yes, Nana Mava and surrounding Ring Road plots are standard stops.

name: Ranchi
intro: Ringed by waterfalls and hills, Jharkhand’s capital keeps tribal-rooted festivals close to office-park modernity. Gifts reach Lalpur’s shops, Harmu’s housing boards and Doranda’s cantonment-flavoured lanes through our eastern express line.

faqs.q: Do you deliver during Sarhul and Karma festivals?
faqs.a: Yes — these treasured Ranchi festivals follow the lunar calendar; we align slots with community timings when requested.

faqs.q: Is Hinoo and Doranda belt covered?
faqs.a: Yes, the airport-side belt including Doranda completes within the standard window.

name: Salem
intro: Steel and mangoes define Salem — the city that smelts and the orchards that sweeten Tamil Nadu summers. We deliver steadily across Fairlands’ quiet avenues, Ammapet’s trade streets and Shevapet’s wholesale maze.

faqs.q: Do you offer mango-season gifting in Salem?
faqs.a: Summer is Salem’s sweet spot — customers often pair our hampers with local mango boxes; ask us about combined delivery.

faqs.q: Is Shevapet’s market area serviceable for deliveries?
faqs.a: Yes — the wholesale lanes get bike-based drops with call-ahead coordination.

name: Shillong
intro: The Scotland of the East trades in pine air, rock concerts and cherry blossoms. We deliver cakes, flowers and cosy gift hampers up the winding roads from Police Bazar to Laitumkhrah and Laban.

faqs.q: Do foggy days delay Shillong deliveries?
faqs.a: Occasionally — hill weather is respected in our scheduling, and we proactively update you if visibility slows a route.

faqs.q: Can gifts reach Laitumkhrah’s cafés and homes?
faqs.a: Yes, Laitumkhrah is a central stop on every Shillong run.

name: Siliguri
intro: Corridor to Sikkim, Bhutan and the wider Northeast, Siliguri brews commerce from four states’ worth of footfall. We deliver along Hill Cart Road’s full length, from Hakim Para to the newer Uttarayon township.

faqs.q: Can you deliver toward Sevoke Road’s tea estates?
faqs.a: City-side Sevoke Road is standard; estate bungalows further out are quoted case-by-case on WhatsApp.

faqs.q: Is Matigara covered within normal windows?
faqs.a: Yes, Matigara and Dagapur complete within the usual 48–72 hours.

name: Srinagar
intro: Dal Lake’s shikaras, saffron fields up the road and pashmina looms in the old city make Srinagar inherently gifty. We ship celebration hampers and dry-fruit boxes to Lal Chowk, Rajbagh and Hyderpora through weather-aware routing.

faqs.q: Does winter snow affect delivery timelines in Srinagar?
faqs.a: Sometimes — heavy snowfall pauses movement for safety; we resume with priority to pending orders once roads reopen.

faqs.q: Can you deliver to houseboats on Dal Lake?
faqs.a: Yes — shore-point handovers with owner coordination make houseboat deliveries possible.

name: Surat
intro: The diamond and textile capital polishes much of the world’s gems, weaves much of its fabric — then throws the grandest Navratri outside Ahmedabad. We deliver across Vesu’s towers, Varachha’s heartland and Adajan’s riverside density.

faqs.q: Can you deliver during Navratri night hours in Surat?
faqs.a: Garba nights run late — we schedule daytime and early-evening drops that week so gifts never miss the celebration.

faqs.q: Is Dumas Road’s resort belt covered?
faqs.a: Yes, the beach-road belt including Dumas is served with front-desk handovers.

name: Thiruvananthapuram
intro: Kerala’s capital spreads between the gilded Padmanabhaswamy temple and Technopark’s campus gates. We deliver cakes, plants and Onam-ready hampers from Vellayambalam’s roundabouts to Kazhakootam’s tech cafés.

faqs.q: Do you deliver Onam hampers in Thiruvananthapuram?
faqs.a: Yes — Onam week is peak season here; pre-orders get priority slots across the city.

faqs.q: Can gifts reach Technopark campuses?
faqs.a: Daily — reception handovers across Technopark’s phases are routine.

name: Thrissur
intro: Kerala’s cultural capital beats Pooram drums and runs one of India’s great gold markets. Festive deliveries spike here — sweet boxes, silk-friendly gift wraps and flowers travel from East Fort round to Punkunnam and Viyyur.

faqs.q: Can you deliver during Thrissur Pooram week?
faqs.a: Pooram closes the Round’s approaches — we deliver citywide that week but avoid parade hours; early-morning slots work best.

faqs.q: Is Mannuthy’s veterinary-university belt covered?
faqs.a: Yes, Mannuthy completes within the standard Thrissur window.

name: Tiruchirappalli
intro: Rockfort’s sky-high temple watches over Trichy’s college crowds and Srirangam’s temple-town calm. We deliver across Thillai Nagar’s showrooms, Tennur’s homes and Ponmalai’s railway quarters.

faqs.q: Do you deliver on Srirangam island?
faqs.a: Yes — the island’s streets are covered, with car-free festival days routed around respectfully.

faqs.q: Can I send gifts to NIT Trichy hostels?
faqs.a: Yes — hostel gate handovers at NIT and other campuses are coordinated with the receiver.

name: Tirupati
intro: Pilgrims stream up the Tirumala hills year-round, and the town below hums with laddu-famous devotion. We deliver pooja-appropriate hampers, flowers and family celebration cakes from the Alipiri foothills to Tiruchanoor’s ashram belt.

faqs.q: Can you deliver to Tirumala itself?
faqs.a: Hill-top Tirumala needs special permissions — we deliver Tirupati town fully and assess Tirumala requests individually.

faqs.q: Are pooja-friendly gifts available for Tirupati?
faqs.a: Yes — sweets, dry fruits and plants are popular; many customers add laddus from their own darshan for combined gifting.

name: Ujjain
intro: One of Hinduism’s seven holy cities, Ujjain centres life around Mahakal’s courtyard and the Shipra’s ghats. We deliver prasad-style sweet boxes and celebration cakes from Freeganj to Nanakheda, Simhastha crowds notwithstanding.

faqs.q: Can you deliver near Mahakaleshwar temple?
faqs.a: Yes — surrounding lanes are served on foot-bike delivery; Bhasma aarti mornings are best avoided for time-sensitive gifts.

faqs.q: What happens during Simhastha (Kumbh) in Ujjain?
faqs.a: The mela transforms the city — we run adjusted routes with pre-booked slots only; plan weeks ahead if visiting then.

name: Varanasi
intro: The world’s oldest living city weaves Banarasi silk by day and lights the ghats by evening. We deliver across Godowlia’s ghatside lanes, the BHU-gate bustle of Lanka and the newer Sigra-Cantt belt — aarti timings respectfully noted.

faqs.q: Can you deliver to hotels near the ghats?
faqs.a: Yes — vehicle-free zones near Dashashwamedh use foot-couriers; allow extra minutes during evening aarti.

faqs.q: Do you cover Sarnath’s monastery belt?
faqs.a: Yes, Sarnath completes within the standard Varanasi window, monastery receptions included.

name: Vijayawada
intro: Under Kanaka Durga’s hill, Vijayawada runs Andhra’s business calendar — and celebrates it with equal appetite. We deliver from Benz Circle’s showrooms to Autonagar’s workshops, with extra runners during Ugadi week.

faqs.q: Do you deliver during Ugadi in Vijayawada?
faqs.a: Yes — Ugadi is a flagship festival here; we add morning capacity and pre-bookable slots across the city.

faqs.q: Is Poranki’s residential sprawl covered?
faqs.a: Yes, Poranki and Kanuru complete within the standard Vijayawada window.

name: Visakhapatnam
intro: Between the Bay and the Eastern Ghats, Vizag balances navy town, steel plant and beach holidays in one breezy skyline. Cakes reach Rushikonda’s resort-side homes; gifts cross MVP Colony and Gajuwaka’s busy sprawl daily.

faqs.q: Can you deliver to beach resorts on Rushikonda?
faqs.a: Yes — resort deliveries use front-desk handovers; guest names and booking details help us find the right sun-lounger.

faqs.q: Is Pendurthi on the outskirts covered?
faqs.a: Yes, Pendurthi follows the standard Vizag schedule with a small transit buffer.

name: Warangal
intro: The Kakatiyas left Warangal its mighty fort gates and the Thousand Pillar Temple, while the tri-city sprawl of Hanamkonda-Kazipet hums with students and traders. We deliver across all three towns’ main belts.

faqs.q: Do Hanamkonda and Kazipet count as Warangal delivery?
faqs.a: Yes — the tri-city is treated as one delivery zone with shared pricing and windows.

faqs.q: Can gifts reach Kakatiya University hostels?
faqs.a: Yes — university-area hostels receive coordinated gate handovers.
